## 2e9bbcd910a7

**Reproduced contract defects; no generated-output counterexample found.**
Generator SHA-256
`9301977697af1a47c63f609e71c4485d90002a7d15c32eb6f2470fc03ac1d8d6`.
The source-bound battery finished with 9 green and 3 failed stages at
`checks/audit/2e9bbcd910a7-battery-v3/`.

The direct control defect is that an unknown override is silently accepted.
Seed 19/sample 23 with `typo_scene_family="tie_se"` produces a valid grid that
is byte-identical to the unoverridden draw; see
`checks/audit/2e9bbcd910a7/unknown_override.json`. The official override stage
reproduces the same unknown-key failure. The semantic stage fails because no
`strict_canonical_like`, executable witnesses, or `lesson_identifiable`
contract is declared. Authority sync reports exact active-text divergence,
although normalized semantics and execution parity pass.

I checked all six advertised scene families through the battery, canonical
profile support, rule smoke, structural self-check, diversity, grammar, and
Racket lint; those stages passed, and I found no input on which the Python mirror
or selected Racket execution mislabeled the winner. The portable task-test run
passed 49 tests and failed 3 for test infrastructure reasons—two missing
snapshot-relative canonical-data files and one raw whitespace-sensitive rule
text assertion (`checks/audit/2e9bbcd910a7-task-tests/result.json`). No fix was
made because this was an audit-only target.

Audited source repo/generators/2e9bbcd910a7/generator.py SHA256 9301977697af1a47c63f609e71c4485d90002a7d15c32eb6f2470fc03ac1d8d6. 
Source binding: generator SHA-256 `9301977697af1a47c63f609e71c4485d90002a7d15c32eb6f2470fc03ac1d8d6`; retained audit return `review-b4138a0a6f4e419e:v0001` with record SHA-256 `b2fb2e04a5630f91b510ed92c7b4a850e6a74a146f70db07ae872adbc2735a99`.

The pinned witness reproduced. For seed `19`, sample index `23`, difficulty `medium`, the undeclared override `typo_scene_family="tie_se"` was accepted rather than rejected. It produced no self-check errors and returned grid SHA-256 `844584c28d6edc8332cf63046fb792595f45c4be12e4cea2246a6a9b599f7bb2`, byte-identical in meaning to both the retained witness and the unoverridden draw. This confirms that an unknown override can be silently ignored while the request appears successful.

Evidence: `checks/tickets/ticket-e8b8b7cb6155e9e8/result.json`, with the exact bounded probe and command in the same directory.

Scope: one retained witness only; no peer battery or search for additional override names was run. No peer source was modified. This reproduction neither clears nor broadens the existing audit and remains subject to maintainer assessment.
 Reviewer-reported bounded finding; preserve stated blocked fresh-Racket/retained-evidence limits where present. No owner rerun, generic safety clearance or target repair.
